d02: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?v) AS ?n) WHERE { ?v a dkh:GeneticVariant ; dkh:fromSample ?s . ?s dkh:hasSampleCode "B" . }
d06: SELECT (MAX(?val) AS ?maxFS) WHERE { ?v dkh:hasAnnotation ?a . ?a dkh:hasAnnotationName "FS" ; dkh:hasNumericValue ?val . }
d08: SELECT ?age WHERE { ?p a dkh:Person ; rdfs:label ?l ; dkh:hasAgeYears ?age . FILTER(STR(?l) = "Sofiia") }
d10: SELECT ?childLabel WHERE { ?m a dkh:Person ; rdfs:label ?ml . FILTER(STR(?ml) = "Maria") ?m dkh:hasChild ?c . ?c rdfs:label ?childLabel . }
d12: SELECT ?val WHERE { ?t a dkh:FilterThreshold ; dkh:onAnnotationName "FS" ; dkh:hasThresholdValue ?val . }
d14: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?a) AS ?n) WHERE { ?a a dkh:QualityAnnotation ; dkh:hasAnnotationName "QD" . }
d16: SELECT DISTINCT ?id WHERE { ?v a dkh:Indel ; dkh:hasVariantId ?id ; dkh:fromSample ?s . ?s dkh:hasSampleCode "A" . }
d18: ASK { ?v a dkh:GeneticVariant ; dkh:locatedIn ?g ; dkh:hasClinicalSignificance ?cs . ?g dkh:hasGeneSymbol "BRCA1" . ?cs rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(STR(?l) = "Benign") }
h02: SELECT ?id WHERE { ?v dkh:hasVariantId ?id ; dkh:hasAnnotation ?a . ?a dkh:hasAnnotationName "MQ" ; dkh:hasNumericValue ?val . } ORDER BY ASC(?val) LIMIT 1
h04: SELECT ?label WHERE { ?v a dkh:GeneticVariant ; dkh:locatedIn ?g . ?g rdfs:label ?label . } GROUP BY ?g ?label HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?v) > 15)
